fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must expire at least 120 days after the date you arrive.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe vencer al menos 120 días después de la fecha de llegada.
entry.quote: your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 120 days after the date you arrive.

entry.en: A visa is not required for visits of 30 days or less.
entry.es: No se requiere visa para visitas de 30 días o menos.
entry.quote: A visa is not required for visits of 30 days or less.

entry.en: Without a valid entry permit you must complete the Customs, Immigration & Quarantine (CIQ) form on arrival.
entry.es: Si no tienes un permiso de entrada válido, debes completar el formulario de Aduanas, Inmigración y Cuarentena (CIQ) al llegar.
entry.quote: you must complete “Customs, Immigration & Quarantine Form (CIQ Form)” on arrival

entry.en: At border control you may need to show a return or onward ticket.
entry.es: En el control fronterizo es posible que debas mostrar un billete de regreso o de continuación.
entry.quote: At the Federated States of Micronesia’s border control, you may need to show a return or onward ticket.

entry.en: You must pay a departure tax of 20 US dollars when you leave.
entry.es: Debes pagar una tasa de salida de 20 dólares estadounidenses al irte.
entry.quote: You must pay a departure tax of 20 US dollars when you leave the Federated States of Micronesia.

entry.en: You must clear immigration even for a domestic flight, so you always need your passport when flying within the FSM.
entry.es: Debes pasar inmigración incluso en vuelos nacionales, así que siempre necesitas el pasaporte para volar dentro de FSM.
entry.quote: You will need to clear immigration even for a domestic flight, so you will always need your passport when you fly in the FSM.

safety.en: Crime levels are low, but the risk is higher at night, particularly if alcohol is involved, and in the state of Chuuk.
safety.es: La criminalidad es baja, pero el riesgo es mayor de noche, sobre todo si hay alcohol, y en el estado de Chuuk.
safety.quote: Crime levels are low. The risk of crime is higher at night, particularly if alcohol is involved. The risk is also higher in the state of Chuuk.

safety.en: There have been reported incidents of sexual assault.
safety.es: Se han reportado incidentes de agresión sexual.
safety.quote: There have been reported incidents of sexual assault.

safety.en: There are heavy penalties for drug offences.
safety.es: Hay penas severas por delitos de drogas.
safety.quote: There are heavy penalties for drug offences.

safety.en: Same-sex relationships are not widely accepted in the Federated States of Micronesia.
safety.es: Las relaciones entre personas del mismo sexo no son ampliamente aceptadas en los Estados Federados de Micronesia.
safety.quote: Same-sex relationships are not widely accepted in the Federated States of Micronesia.

safety.en: There are dangerous currents and waves in parts of the islands.
safety.es: Hay corrientes y olas peligrosas en partes de las islas.
safety.quote: There are dangerous currents and waves in parts of the islands.

safety.en: The islands are vulnerable to natural disasters, including tropical cyclones, floods and severe droughts.
safety.es: Las islas son vulnerables a desastres naturales, como ciclones tropicales, inundaciones y sequías graves.
safety.quote: The islands of the Micronesia region are vulnerable to natural disasters, including tropical cyclones, floods and severe droughts.

health.en: Medical facilities are limited but adequate for uncomplicated treatment.
health.es: Los centros médicos son limitados pero adecuados para tratamientos sencillos.
health.quote: Medical facilities in the Federated States of Micronesia are limited but adequate for uncomplicated treatment.

health.en: For serious or complicated problems you may need medical evacuation to Guam or Australia.
health.es: Para problemas graves o complicados podrías necesitar evacuación médica a Guam o Australia.
health.quote: you may need medical evacuation to Guam or Australia.
Call 911 and ask for an ambulance.

health.en: Wikivoyage says not to drink the tap water.
health.es: Wikivoyage indica que no se debe beber el agua del grifo.

help.en: The emergency number for ambulance, fire and police is 911.
help.es: El número de emergencias para ambulancia, bomberos y policía es el 911.

getting_in.en: Honolulu is the most direct gateway into the islands from North America.
getting_in.es: Honolulu es la puerta de entrada más directa a las islas desde Norteamérica.
getting_in.quote: Honolulu is the most direct gateway into the islands from North America.

getting_in.en: Guam is the most direct gateway from most places in Asia and Australia.
getting_in.es: Guam es la puerta de entrada más directa desde la mayor parte de Asia y Australia.
getting_in.quote: Guam is the most direct gateway from most places in Asia and Australia

getting_in.en: United Airlines operates a thrice-weekly island hopper flight through the islands.
getting_in.es: United Airlines opera tres veces por semana un vuelo "island hopper" por las islas.
getting_in.quote: United Airlines operates a thrice-weekly "island hopper" flight

getting_in.en: The major international ports are Chuuk, Pohnpei and Yap.
getting_in.es: Los principales puertos internacionales son Chuuk, Pohnpei y Yap.
getting_in.quote: The major international ports are; Chuuk, Pohnpei and Yap.

getting_around.en: Taxi services are available throughout the islands and are inexpensive.
getting_around.es: Hay servicio de taxi en todas las islas y es económico.
getting_around.quote: Taxi services are available throughout the islands and are inexpensive.

getting_around.en: There are no scheduled bus services on the island, though some buses can be hired or chartered.
getting_around.es: No hay servicios de autobús regulares en la isla, aunque algunos autobuses se pueden alquilar o contratar.
getting_around.quote: there are no scheduled bus services on the island, some buses are available to hire or charter.

getting_around.en: Self-drive cars are available in major towns and require a national driver's license or International Driving Permit.
getting_around.es: Hay coches de alquiler en las ciudades principales y se requiere licencia nacional o permiso internacional de conducir.
getting_around.quote: It is required to have a National Driver's License or International Driving Permit.

money.en: The official currency of the FSM is the U.S. dollar.
money.es: La moneda oficial de FSM es el dólar estadounidense.
money.quote: the official currency of the FSM nowadays is the U.S. dollar

money.en: Most hotels accept credit cards, but ATM facilities are limited.
money.es: La mayoría de los hoteles acepta tarjetas de crédito, pero los cajeros automáticos son limitados.
money.quote: Most hotels accept credit cards. ATM facilities are limited.

etiquette.en: Some islands are very traditional, especially Yap state, and visitors should respect their culture.
etiquette.es: Algunas islas son muy tradicionales, sobre todo el estado de Yap, y hay que respetar su cultura.
etiquette.quote: Some islands are very traditional, especially Yap state. Be sure to respect their culture.

connectivity.en: Cell service is available with a locally purchased or rented SIM card.
connectivity.es: Hay servicio móvil con una tarjeta SIM comprada o alquilada localmente.
connectivity.quote: Cell service is available with a locally purchased (or rented) SIM card.

connectivity.en: UK mobile phones will not work because there is no international roaming.
connectivity.es: Los teléfonos móviles del Reino Unido no funcionarán porque no hay roaming internacional.
connectivity.quote: Your UK mobile phone will not work in the Federated States of Micronesia because there is no international roaming.
